India has a new ‘Singham’. His name is Tukaram Mundhe, an officer being celebrated, lauded, and pushed to celebrity status for taking on India’s food safety crisis. But what does his style of working reveal about the system? And if one officer can make this much of a difference, why hasn’t the system produced more like him? More importantly, can one officer really fix India’s food safety problem? This video delves into why Tukaram Mundhe is an exception, not the norm, and what it would take to make food safety a system rather than a one-man show
